newsitem.title: USA: Dow near highs after IP tops estimates.
newsitem.headline: Dow near highs after IP tops estimates.

text.p: The Dow industrials rallied to test their session highs in late-afternoon, drawing renewed strength after component International Paper Co beat Wall Street estimates with its second quarter operating earnings.

The Dow stood at 7925, up 66 points. IP led the Dow advance, climbing 2-9/16 to 53-3/4, extending its earlier gains after reporting a second quarter operating profit of $0.20 per share before charges totalling $685 million.
The operating result beat First Call's consensus estimate by $0.05.
IP became the second Dow component to beat Wall Street estimates in as many days, reporting a day after Aluminum Co of America posted surprisingly strong results for the second quarter.
